fields.description: List of the specific fields, and the errors found with their contents

Fulfillment.description: A fulfillment represents a task to fulfill one or more items from a single location for a single fulfillment mode. A Fulfillment can exist in the context of an order or be independent of one.

fulfillmentPlanId.description: Reference to the FulfillmentPlan this fulfillment was created from. Used for linking and reporting.

history.description: List of history events associated to the fulfillment

id.description: An identifier unique to the fulfillment (`Fulfillment_<KSUID>`). Auto-generated by our system on creation

inventoryBehavior.description: Inventory policy for this fulfillment. Valid values: OBEY_POLICY (default), BYPASS. OBEY_POLICY decrements inventory and enforces stock checks; BYPASS skips inventory checks and allows fulfillment regardless of stock.

locationId.description: Reference to the Inventory Location (as defined by the Inventory Service) where the fulfillment was processed at

notes.description: List of FulfillmentNote objects, used for internal or customer-facing notes.

orderId.description: Reference to an order as defined by the Orders Service

storeId.description: ID of the store that the fulfillment belongs to

trackingData.description: Tracking information for a fulfillment. The ability to have multiple tracking numbers for a single fulfillment is to support `last mile` shipping use cases. We do not support fulfilling multiple discrete sets of items (e.g. multiple boxes) in a single fulfillment

Fulfillment.title: Fulfillment

FulfillmentAddress.title: Fulfillment Address

FulfillmentDetailedStatus.description:
Detailed status for a fulfillment providing more granular information about the fulfillment state. This field is required for all fulfillment operations. 

 **For updates**: Must be present and be one of the valid detailed statuses. 

 **For creates**: Must be present and valid for the initial status being set (see fulfillment-constraints.json for validation rules). 

 **Status Values**: 

 `ERROR`: There was an error when trying to process the fulfillment 

 `CANCELED`: The fulfillment has been canceled 

 `CONFIRMED`: The fulfillment has been confirmed and is ready to be processed 

 `AWAITING_FULFILLMENT`: The fulfillment is awaiting fulfillment processing 

 `OUT_FOR_FULFILLMENT`: The fulfillment is out for fulfillment (e.g., shipped, out for delivery) 

 `ATTEMPTED_FULFILLMENT`: An attempt was made to fulfill the order but was unsuccessful 

 `SUCCESS`: The fulfillment has been completed successfully 

 `AWAITING_PICKUP`: The fulfillment is ready for pickup
FulfillmentDetailedStatus.title: Fulfillment detailed status

FulfillmentItem.description: Represents an item that's included in a fulfillment / fulfillment plan

fulfillmentPlanItemId.description: Reference to the FulfillmentPlanItem this item fulfills. Required if the fulfillment is linked to a plan.

lineItemId.description: Reference to a Line Item as defined by the Order service. Optional since fulfillments do not have to be tied to an order.

name.description: Name of the fulfillment item used for display purposes

productId.description: Reference to a Product as defined by the Catalog service (commerce API v1). Optional.

quantity.description: Quantity for the fulfillment item. Note this could be a float value (e.g. 2.3 Kgs)

sku.description: SKU for the fulfillment item. Optional. Deprecated in v2

skuId.description: Reference to a SKU as defined by the Catalog service (commerce API v2). Optional.

FulfillmentItem.title: Fulfillment Item

FulfillmentNote.description: Represents a note attached to a fulfillment, which may be customer-facing or internal

author.description: Name or identifier of the note's author.

authorType.description: Type of author. Used for filtering and display. Defaults to CUSTOMER.

content.description: The note content, which may be customer-facing or internal.

id.description: Unique identifier for the note. Used for referencing and editing notes.

FulfillmentNote.title: Fulfillment Note

FulfillmentPlan.description: A fulfillment plan is a task list with instructions on how to fulfill a group of one or more items from an order from a single location for a single fulfillment mode. An order can have multiple fulfillment plans

cartId.description: Optional reference to the cart associated with the order, if the order originated from a cart.

hasErrors.description: True if any item in the plan encountered an error during inventory sync or fulfillment. This flag is set when errors are detected and is used to block further processing, trigger alerts, and surface issues for operator intervention.

history.description: List of history events associated to the fulfillment plan

id.description: An identifier unique to the fulfillment plan (`FulfillmentPlan_<KSUID>`). Auto-generated by our system on creation

locationId.description: Reference to the Inventory Location (as defined by the Inventory Service) where the fulfillment was processed at

orderId.description: Reference to an order as defined by the Orders Service

storeId.description: ID of the store that the fulfillment plan belongs to

FulfillmentPlan.title: Fulfillment Plan

backorderedQuantity.description: The quantity that could not be reserved due to insufficient stock and is placed on backorder. Set by inventory sync flows based on inventory API responses.

canceledQuantity.description: The quantity of this item that has been canceled and will not be fulfilled. Updated when cancellations are processed; used to release inventory and update plan status.

error.description: Error message if inventory sync or fulfillment failed for this item. Set by inventory sync flows when exceptions or API errors occur.

fulfilledQuantity.description: The quantity of this item that has been successfully fulfilled (e.g., shipped, delivered, or picked up). Updated as fulfillments are processed; used to determine if the item is complete.

id.description: Unique identifier for the plan item. Used for referencing in fulfillments, cancellations, and inventory reservations.

inProgressQuantity.description: The quantity currently in the process of being fulfilled (e.g., picked, packed, but not yet shipped). Used to track work-in-progress and drive inventory status updates.

reservedQuantity.description: The quantity currently reserved in the external inventory system for this item. Set by inventory sync flows to prevent overselling; released or decremented as fulfillments or cancellations occur.

skuId.description: Reference to a SKU as defined by the Catalog service (commerce API v2). Used for catalog lookups and cross-service integration.

status.description: The current workflow status of this item (IN_PROGRESS, COMPLETED, CANCELED). Drives item-level fulfillment and inventory actions.

FulfillmentPlanItem.description: Represents an item that's included in a fulfillment plan
FulfillmentPlanItem.title: Fulfillment Plan Item

FulfillmentPlanStatus.description:
Possible statuses for a fulfillment plan 

 `OPEN`: The fulfillment plan is ready to be worked on 

 `IN_PROGRESS`: The fulfillment plan is being processed 

 `COMPELTED`: The fulfillment plan has been completed successfully 

 `CANCELED`: The fulfillment plan has been canceled
FulfillmentPlanStatus.title: Fulfillment Plan status

FulfillmentPlan_orderId.description: Reference to an order as defined by the Orders Service

FulfillmentPlan_storeId.description: ID of the store that the fulfillment plan belongs to

FulfillmentStatus.description:
Possible statuses for a fulfillment 

 `IN_PROGRESS`: The fulfillment has been acknowledged by a fulfillment service and is in progress 

 `SUCCESS`: The fulfillment has been completed successfully 

 `CANCELED`: The fulfillment has been canceled 

 `ERROR`: There was an error when trying to process the fulfillment
FulfillmentStatus.title: Fulfillment status

FulfillmentWindow.description: Specifies the time window for fulfillment (e.g., delivery slot or pickup time)
FulfillmentWindow.title: Fulfillment Window

Fulfillment_id.description: An identifier unique to the fulfillment (`Fulfillment_<KSUID>`). Auto-generated by our system on creation

HistoryEvent.description: Records a event that happened to a fulfillment / fulfillment plan
HistoryEvent.title: History event

Mode.description:
Possible modes for a fulfillment 

 `SHIP`: The fulfillment is a shipping fulfillment 

 `DELIVERY` The fulfillment is a local delivery fulfillment 

 `PICKUP` The fulfillment is a pickup fulfillment 

 `FOR_HERE` The fulfillment is made at the location with no online interaction 

 `DIGITAL` The fulfillment is a digital fulfillment
Mode.title: Fulfillment mode

labelId.description: Reference to a Label as defined by the Label Service

address.description: An internationalized postal address. Maps to [AddressValidationMetadata](https://github.com/googlei18n/libaddressinput/wiki/AddressValidationMetadata) from Google's Address Data Service and HTML 5.1 [Autofilling form controls: the autocomplete attribute](https://www.w3.org/TR/html51/sec-forms.html#autofilling-form-controls-the-autocomplete-attribute).

addressDetails.description: The non-portable additional address details that are sometimes needed for compliance, risk, or other scenarios where fine-grain address information might be needed. Not portable with common third-party and open-source address libraries and redundant with core fields. For example, `address.addressLine1` is usually a combination of `addressDetails.streetNumber` and `streetName` and `streetType`.

buildingName.description: A named locations that represents the premise. Usually a building name or number or collection of buildings with a common name or number. For example, Craven House.

deliveryService.description: The delivery service. Post office box, bag number, or post office name.

streetName.description: The street name. Just `Drury` in `Drury Lane`.

streetType.description: The street type. For example, avenue, boulevard, road, or expressway.

subBuilding.description: The first-order entity below a named building or location that represents the sub-premise. Usually a single building within a collection of buildings with a common name. Can be a flat, story, floor, room, or apartment.

addressDetails.title: Address Details

addressLine1.description: The first line of the address. For example, number and street name. For example, `3032 Bunker Hill Lane`. Required for compliance and risk checks. Must contain the full address.

addressLine2.description: The second line of the address. For example, office suite or apartment number.

addressLine3.description: The third line of the address, if needed. For example, a street complement for Brazil; direction text, such as `next to Opera House`; or a landmark reference in an Indian address.

adminArea1.description: The highest level sub-division in a country, which is usually a province, state, or ISO-3166-2 subdivision; formatted for postal delivery. For example, `CA` and not `California`. For example, for UK - A county; for USs - A state; for Canada - A province; for Japan - A prefecture; for Switzerland - A kanton.

adminArea2.description: A city, town, or village. Smaller than `adminArea1`.

adminArea3.description: A sub-locality, suburb, neighborhood, or district. Smaller than `adminArea2`. For example, in Brazil - Suburb, bairro, or neighborhood; in India - Sub-locality or district. Street name information may not always available and a sub-locality or district can reference a very small area.

adminArea4.description: The neighborhood, ward, or district. Smaller than `adminArea3` or `subLocality`. For example, the postal sorting code that is used in Guernsey and many French territories, such as French Guiana; the fine-grained administrative levels in China.

postalCode.description: The postal code, which is the zip code or equivalent. Typically required for countries that have a postal code or an equivalent. See [Postal code](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Postal_code).

address.title: Postal Address (Medium-Grained)

country-code.description: A two-character ISO 3166-1 code that identifies the country or region.

date-time.description: A date and time, in [Internet date and time format](https://tools.ietf.org/html/rfc3339#section-5.6). Note: The regular expression provides static schematic guidance but does not reject all invalid dates.

href.description: The complete target URL, or link, to use in combination with the method to make the related call, as defined by [RFC 6570 - URI Template](https://tools.ietf.org/html/rfc6570), with the addition of the `$`, `(`, and `)` characters for pre-processing. The `href` is the key HATEOAS component that links a completed call with a subsequent call.

method.description: The method to use to request the link target. For example, for HTTP, this might be `GET` or `DELETE`.

rel.description: The [link relation type](https://tools.ietf.org/html/rfc5988#section-4), which is an identifier for a link that unambiguously describes the semantics of the link. For values, see [Link Relationship Types](https://www.iana.org/assignments/link-relations/link-relations.xhtml).

submissionMediaType.description: The media type with which to submit data with the request.

submissionSchema.description: The schema that describes the request data.

targetMediaType.description: The [RFC 2046-defined media type](https://www.ietf.org/rfc/rfc2046.txt) that describes the link target.

targetSchema.description: The schema that describes the link target.
